purpose: Local, relative code A/B of OpenIVM-Spark candidates against deployed v2 on the user's six-MV walkthrough. It shortlists candidates for Fabric; it never accepts a release.

primary.label: PRIMARY - live six-MV CDF walkthrough
primary.definition: Captured notebook (capture b1d22ce2, definition e31177a9): parallel_events seeded, one INSERT, then six concurrent REFRESH MATERIALIZED VIEW concurrent_1..6 (SELECT symbol, COUNT(*), SUM(amount * k) GROUP BY symbol) in effective CDF mode. Durable completion = every request's INSIGHTS row and drained telemetry are visible.

companion.label: COMPANION - matched intercept six-MV INSERT (never pooled with the primary)
companion.definition: R6 matched-intercept shape: three seed rows, one three-row INSERT, six concurrent refreshes in intercept mode. Regression signal only; it can never qualify a CDF win.

default.note: Captured walkthrough settings (including queue enabled) on both arms, with additional R7 driver/task detail off; not the all-telemetry-disabled product default.

instrumented-default.note: The reviewed combined source on both arms, with the captured walkthrough queue and optional deep detail off.

instrumented-deep.note: Diagnostic profile with both optional layers enabled on both arms. Never mix with default-profile timings.

shortlist.order: alternating AB, BA, AB, ...; the control runs first in odd pairs
shortlist.metric: per-pair 100 * (control - candidate) / control of the workload's scored_metric

native_rule.relation: Separate and stricter. The R7 scorecard only passes a native decision through; it never overwrites accepted=false and never sets release acceptance.

comparison_classes.code-ab: The only class this scorecard scores: different product commits, identical harness bytes, native binaries, observer settings and six workers on both arms.
comparison_classes.observer-cost: Same product commit, observer settings toggled. Reported separately; never subtracted from or added to a code-ab result.
comparison_classes.config-sweep: Same commit, product settings changed. Reported separately.
comparison_classes.serial-vs-parallel: Same-binary concurrency comparison inside one report. Never a code gain.

exclusions.post_hoc: None. Every planned arm is scored or the series is invalid.
exclusions.failed_arm: Any failed, cancelled, wrong-target or gate-failing arm invalidates the whole series; later arms are recorded as not-run.
exclusions.retest: A retest is a new registered series. Group every registration by hypothesis family (lane and hypothesis label), profile, workload and target. Admit the family only with at least one valid series, every valid series shortlisted, and an independent D8 classification unrelated to performance for every invalid or cancelled series. An unclassified failure, timeout or performance-dependent failure prevents admission.

coverage_limits: Phase spans are nested and non-additive; a phase missing on any request is unavailable, never zero.
Command return is not durable completion; a candidate that only moves work after the return earns no credit.
awaitDrain return is not physical persistence; polling is never relabelled or subtracted as commit time.
Task telemetry does not observe callbacks that arrive after the last owner JobEnd; observer time excludes prefilters and identity checks and is not total overhead.
Local file:// storage with modeled catalog and state-sync latency is relative evidence only; it bounds neither OneLake/ABFSS I/O nor telemetry export cost.

cw_6333eb94.use: Historical intercept context only. Never a CDF control, never compounded with an R7 result.
